title: National Investigation Agency v. Yasin Bhatkal @ Mohammed Ahmed Siddibappa (Dilsukhnagar Serial Blasts)
crime_type: Urban Terrorist Bombing / Mass Casualty Improvised Explosive Device (IED)
court_or_authority: NIA Special Court, Hyderabad / High Court for the State of Telangana
legal_citation: Special SC No. 1/2014 (NIA); 2016 SCC OnLine Hyd 512; 2017 CriLJ 1421
source: National Investigation Agency Official Chargesheet & Indian Kanoon (doc/9281721)
ipc_sections: Section 121 IPC (Waging war against Government of India)
location: Dilsukhnagar Bus Stand & Venkatadri Theatre, Hyderabad, Telangana, India

suspects.name: Yasin Bhatkal
suspects.role: Operational Commander / IED Fabricator / Convicted Offender

evidence: High-definition CCTV video surveillance recording suspects strapping explosive-laden bicycles outside Anand Tiffin Centre and bus shelter
Forensic debris analysis confirming Ammonium Nitrate Fuel Oil (ANFO) chemical mixture laced with steel ball bearings and digital quartz timers
Seizure of testing equipment, wires, soldering irons, and precursor chemicals from hideout safehouse in Mangalore and Miraj
Digital extraction of encrypted proxy email communications and chat transcripts coordinated with overseas command servers
Chain of purchase records tracing bicycles bought from Hyderabad local cycle shop days prior to blast
modus_operandi: Procured commercial-grade ammonium nitrate and detonators from mining supply conduits. Fabricated multi-component IEDs with timer delay switches packed into tiffin boxes. Mounted explosive assemblies on newly purchased bicycles. Parked bicycles in crowded evening commuter zones (outside popular snack stall and crowded bus depot) timed to detonate within two minutes of each other to maximize secondary casualty impact.
personality_disorder: Forensic intelligence assessment identified extreme ideological radicalization, calculated psychopathic indifference to civilian life, high technical competence in improvised ordnance, and compartmentalized operational tradecraft.
common_traits: Targeting high-density civilian evening transit hubs
Dual synchronized detonations (timed intervals of 100-120 seconds)
Concealment in everyday commuter transport (bicycles, tiffin containers)
Use of industrial ammonium nitrate boosted with high-velocity shrapnel (iron ball bearings)
Cross-state decentralized logistics and encrypted digital command coordination
summary: Historic National Investigation Agency (NIA) prosecution resulting in the first capital convictions of Indian Mujahideen leadership. Established legal precedents regarding digital encrypted evidence, international border apprehension, and scientific explosive debris reconstruction.
